title: Odds step for positive bias
statement: Let $n\ge 2$, and let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube whose positive bias $p$ satisfies $0<p<1$. Choose a coordinate $i$ of maximum influence, where influence is the fraction of inputs on which flipping that coordinate changes the function, and let $p'$ be the fraction of inputs on which $f$ is positive after coordinate $i$ is set to $+1$. Then, with $r=\log(n)/(100n)$, $(1+2r)p(1-p')\le p'(1-p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$i$ is the coordinate selected to have maximum influence
